name: v7m-portal/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the V7M Unified Portal — promoter commissions, partner hubs, and platform administration tools.

tools.name: notify_send
tools.description: Send a notification via WhatsApp and/or email.

tools.name: notify_send_event
tools.description: Send notification using registered event template with placeholders.

tools.name: notify_status
tools.description: Check notification status, delivery state and errors.

tools.name: notify_history
tools.description: Query notification delivery history with status filters.

tools.name: notify_inbox
tools.description: Retrieve inbound messages received by the platform.

tools.name: notify_phone_check
tools.description: Verify if phone numbers exist on WhatsApp.

tools.name: notify_channels
tools.description: List configured WhatsApp and email delivery channels.

tools.name: notify_templates
tools.description: List event notification templates for the platform.

tools.name: notify_template_upsert
tools.description: Create or update an event notification template.
